title: Return a greeting
summary: Spring Boot: Return a greeting. Change the message.
introduction: @RestController makes return values into HTTP responses. GET /hello calls this method.
learningObjectives: Return a greeting with Spring Boot

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Return a greeting

blocks.text: Boot configures an HTTP server and imports the controller. GetMapping connects /hello to its returned text.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A mapping must use the same path and HTTP method as the request.

seo.title: Spring Boot: Return a greeting
seo.description: Spring Boot: Return a greeting. Change the message. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
